milestone: H2-v2 M2g — unexplained source-transition semantics diagnosis
goal: Determine whether the 124 M2f UNEXPLAINED_SOURCE_TRANSITION pairs can be localized to trade events that were not captured by the M2f same-token ingest-interval rule, specifically through websocket arrival ordering or same-market complementary-token matching.
primary_question: Do trade events outside the M2f same-token ingest-window association rule account for the remaining 124 source transitions?

official_semantics_basis.book: Full orderbook snapshot; documented as emitted on subscription and when a trade affects the book.
official_semantics_basis.price_change: Price-level update documented for new-order and cancellation activity.
official_semantics_basis.complementary_matching: Binary outcome orders can match at complementary prices whose probabilities sum to 1.

candidate_trade_event.market_requirement: Candidate raw trade event must have the same market identifier as the base/checkpoint ws_book pair.

INGEST_INTERVAL.definition: base raw frame_sequence exclusive through checkpoint raw frame_sequence inclusive

BOOK_EVENT_TIME_INTERVAL.definition: base ws_book server timestamp exclusive through checkpoint ws_book server timestamp inclusive

EXACT_CHECKPOINT_TIMESTAMP.definition: trade server timestamp exactly equals checkpoint ws_book server timestamp

prohibited_candidate_windows: nearest-trade distance thresholds selected after observing results

event_ordering_test.same_token_out_of_order_candidate: Same-token last_trade_price has server timestamp within the frozen BOOK_EVENT_TIME_INTERVAL but its raw frame lies outside the frozen INGEST_INTERVAL.
event_ordering_test.same_market_other_token_candidate: Different-token last_trade_price has the same market identifier and falls within at least one frozen temporal scope.
event_ordering_test.exact_timestamp_candidate: Any same-market last_trade_price whose server timestamp exactly equals checkpoint ws_book timestamp.

level_accounting.same_market_different_token_side_alignme: No side constraint because no official side-mapping assumption is frozen for complementary-token execution.
level_accounting.size_coverage_rule: For an individual mismatch level, sum the sizes of eligible price-aligned candidate trade events. The level is size-covered only if aggregate candidate trade size is greater than or equal to the observed quantity reduction.
level_accounting.pair_direct_accounting_rule: A pair is DIRECT_TRADE_ACCOUNTING_SUPPORTED only if every mismatch level in that pair is price-aligned and size-covered by eligible candidate trade events.

pair_classifications.INVALID_PAIR_METADATA: Required base/checkpoint raw provenance, market identifier, or book timestamp is absent or inconsistent.
pair_classifications.DIRECT_TRADE_ACCOUNTING_SUPPORTED: At least one eligible trade candidate exists and every replay mismatch level satisfies the frozen price and size accounting rule.
pair_classifications.TRADE_CANDIDATE_BUT_INCOMPLETE_ACCOUNTIN: One or more eligible candidate trades exist but the frozen level accounting rule does not fully cover the pair.
pair_classifications.NO_ELIGIBLE_TRADE_CANDIDATE: No last_trade_price event satisfies any frozen candidate scope.
